learned_rules: Avoid entering trades during high volatility periods, as seen in the cases of ZECUSDT where large price movements triggered stop-losses.
Implement a trailing stop loss to lock in profits and minimize losses. The example with BTWUSDT shows that locking profit at 0.2368% was beneficial compared to waiting until it hit -1.0461%.
Be cautious when using grid execution auto-exit as it can lead to unexpected losses, particularly with high volatility. ZECUSDT's case of losing 0.5395% highlights this risk.
